card.name: Nouns for doses, taxes and timing
card.fires_on: The object noun after a verb or adjective of changing or fixing something, mostly dose or time in dosing directions, and taxes in economic text. It also fires on 'in' in a beekeeping instruction.

modes.label: Dose and time in dosing text
modes.description: The noun dose or time right after words like same, usual, single, recommended or their.
modes.example: should be taken once daily, at approximately the same<< time>> every day

modes.label: Taxes in economic text
modes.description: The word tax or taxes after cutting, raised or spending-bill phrases.
modes.example: Conservatives favor cutting<< taxes>>, liberals prefer to spend money borrowed from

modes.label: Hive instruction
modes.description: The word 'in' after a beekeeping action phrase.
modes.example: Reversing the hive bodies<< in>> the spring results in having an empty hive
